title: AI Solves Language Processing Brain Code Errors #shorts
description: Imagine the brain's language system as a massive computer. For those with language difficulties, it's like having errors in the code. AI is now the key to pinpointing and solving these individual processing challenges. #LanguageProcessing #BrainScience #ArtificialIntelligence #Neuroscience
